changelog: **Program journey engine (#1852):** new `ProgramStep` (an offset from an anchor — relation start, programme start or stage entry — with audience, action and per-locale title, hung off the programme container) and `ProgramStepRun` (one row per step × relation; `@@unique([stepId, relationId])` is the claim, so a second sweep or replica delivers nothing). The pure rule is `src/lib/programJourneyRule.ts` (whitelisted vocabularies, a 7-day lookback so publishing a journey on a live programme does not back-fire, stage-anchored steps resolved against the org's own pipeline and reported as `unresolved` when it lacks the key); `src/lib/programJourney.ts` runs the bounded daily sweep at 07:10 UTC (`GET /api/cron?job=program-journey`, caller's org only, `?at=` pins the clock), records a step whose `skipIf` fact already holds as skipped with its reason, and delivers in-app through `notifyIfAllowed` (`mentorship` category) — `ASSIGN_TODO` adds a goal to the pair. `ProgramStep` is in `TENANT_MODELS`. Design: `docs/program-journey.md`.
